description: Delete a user account and related files.

option.name: --force
tip: Force some actions that would fail otherwise, e.g. removal of user still logged in or files, even if not owned by the user.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Apply changes to configuration files under the root filesystem found under PREFIX_DIR.
This option does not chroot and is intended for preparing a cross-compilation target.

option.name: --remove
tip: Remove home directory and mail spool.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.

option.name: --selinux-user
tip: Remove any SELinux user mapping for the user.
